runtime_decision: Keep Python-only predicate caching. Reject automatic expansion on the available evidence.
scope: Exploratory local measurements, not physical kitty/display latency; query timing and wheel timing are separate probes.

query_probe.scope: Four AB/BA rounds, 160 viewport query iterations per target per round. Collect GC before each mode; measure query iteration only. setup_ms excludes the native query compilation already performed for comparison. Captures/ranges/metadata matched.

excluded_comparisons.java: No valid full comparison: first run could not create a JDTLS workspace outside the sandbox; after isolating generated data, JDTLS exited and native java ftplugin cleanup left E216 in v:errmsg. No wheel speed claim is made.
excluded_comparisons.cpp: Old observer assumed three logical lines per wheel step, which diagnostic virtual rows invalidate; the next version reached the upper buffer edge before its last up event. Those comparisons are excluded. Final observer validates decoded-event pairing away from edges.

protocol_notes.preliminary: Original top-line mapping, 1.8 s settle, two AB/BA rounds, four bursts each. No measurement is accepted after a failed assertion.
protocol_notes.lua_four_round_recheck: Decoded-event pairing with isolated generated data, 1.8 s settle, four AB/BA rounds.
protocol_notes.settled_recheck: Decoded-event pairing with isolated generated data, 8 s settle, two AB/BA rounds. Lua and Go had only an initialized typos_lsp client, with no pending requests at the observed checkpoints. Longer settling did not establish a general cache benefit.
protocol_notes.final_script: The committed observer additionally records virtual row/wrap offsets, uses fixed start anchors 10/90, and requires at least 140 source lines. Earlier measurements are not directly pooled with this new protocol.

cpp.scope: Observer smoke check only, no speed comparison. Full configuration; runtime files unchanged from baseline.

python.scope: Observer smoke check only, no speed comparison. Full configuration; runtime files unchanged from baseline.
